content: {"answer_sections":[{"text":"According to the consulted source, Manetas utilized Phournoi as a base and secure anchorage during his operations in the Chios area in 1694 and 1695 remains a conjecture.","claim_ids":["c-7629683ed5d4d47fd9dc"]},{"text":"Local traditions suggest that the murder took place either in Ikaria or Phournoi, specifically in the bays of Pano and Kato Maneta.","claim_ids":["c-0ecde140d07aa9e67f96"]},{"text":"The British governor constructed a fort on New Providence in 1695 and named it Nassau in honor of King William III.","claim_ids":["c-01e3d44fe0577a38501a"]}], "unknowns":["gaps including unresolved identities and dates"], "limitations":["limitations"]}
